verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community comment saying Fastmail is up front about how data is handled and what that means for privacy. Nothing in the pack shows tracking-pixel or remote-image blocking, by default or otherwise; Masked Email is an anti-spam alias feature, not tracker protection. Missing for 10: any evidence of read-pixel or remote-content blocking, default-on tracker protection, and first-party documentation of the data-handling or privacy policy.
